substitution.reason: Repeated SSL connection timeouts for index and daily ozone payload
substitution.selection: First three ordered measured-data reserves; preserves overall corpus breadth but reduces new survey and environmental additions.

measurement_dates: Source filenames include 2018–2021 sessions; release July 2026.

known_analyses_and_limitations: Animal/session holdouts, with cells and trials nested. Published representation findings are prior analysis; these are not raw fluorescence movies.
independent_groups: animal/session; trials and cells nested within animals
